claim: CNN announces on social media that President Donald Trump dies from COVID-19.

sub_claims.question: Did CNN make a social media announcement on October 13, 2020, stating that President Donald Trump died from COVID-19?
sub_claims.answer: No, CNN did not make such an announcement; Donald Trump was alive and had recovered from COVID-19 by that date.

evidence.statement: Donald Trump tested positive for COVID-19 on October 2, 2020, and was discharged from Walter Reed Medical Center on October 5, 2020, after recovering from the disease.

sub_claims.question: Was President Donald Trump alive on October 13, 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Donald Trump was alive on October 13, 2020, having been discharged from Walter Reed Medical Center on October 5, 2020.

evidence.statement: Donald Trump held a campaign rally in Sanford, Florida, on October 12, 2020.
On October 15, 2020, Donald Trump participated in an NBC News town hall event, confirming he was alive after October 13, 2020.

sub_claims.question: Did Donald Trump die from COVID-19?
sub_claims.answer: No, Donald Trump survived COVID-19 and did not die from the disease.

evidence.statement: Donald Trump completed his term as President on January 20, 2021, and did not die from COVID-19.
